title: Spec asserts middleware.redact_token_route covers /reference/* — no such arm exists
evidence: Spec line 158: "The token-redaction registry (`middleware.redact_token_route`) covers `/reference/*` server-side; the helpers must not add a second leak path." Actual middleware.gleam:330-342: `fn redact_token_route(segments: List(String)) -> Result(String, Nil) { case segments { ["dsar", ..] -> Ok("/dsar/<redacted>") / ["erase", ..] -> Ok("/erase/<redacted>") / ["apply", code, "resume", ..] -> ... / ["apply", code, "draft-erasure", ..] -> ... / _ -> Error(Nil) } }` — no ["reference", ..] arm (grep for `\["reference"` in middleware.gleam returns nothing).
detail: The merged spec states a safety control exists when it does not. No leak today (the /reference routes land in rc3-3/rc3-4), but those stories will trust this claim and may skip adding the arm, leaking referee capability tokens into Sentry event paths and access logs.
recommended_fix: Correct the spec sentence to say the arm must be added when rc3-3/rc3-4 land the routes; add ["reference", ..] -> Ok("/reference/<redacted>") to redact_token_route in the story that wires the router entries.
